name: campaign-assistant
description: Codex-native campaign email drafting and review plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Strategize, draft, and review campaign emails with mailing memory.
interface.longDescription: Campaign Assistant is a Codex plugin that mirrors the Eko drafter pipeline for campaign strategy, campaign email drafting, source-aware claims, target-of-change readiness, house voice, progressive language review, and retrieval of high-performing or cautionary historical mailings through the production super-search MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Draft a campaign email from this brief.
Strategize this campaign using past mailing memory.
Review this mailing draft before launch.
